raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid), 0) AS ruling_intensity
FROM main.rulings r
JOIN main.cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN main.sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE r.date >= '2016-11-01' AND r.date < '2016-12-01'
  AND s.releaseDate >= '2016-11-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2016-12-01'
```
